_description: Per-contract metadata for the EMPLOYMENT bucket. Captures industry, employer type, executive vs non-executive role, jurisdiction, deal size (a proxy for compensation tier), negotiation bias, regulatory frameworks, special features, and the canonical drafting style. Read alongside entity_maps.json and the per-contract tokenized templates in ../../tokenized/EMPLOYMENT/synthetic/. Note: in this bucket the CUSTOMER slot holds the EMPLOYEE (always preserved as a special customer type) and the PROVIDER slot holds the EMPLOYER. Use party_roles to relabel for the brief — typically {provider: 'Company', customer: 'Executive'} or {provider: 'Company', customer: 'Employee'}.
